passive.name: Joy Unending
passive.text: Nilah gains increased experience from last-hitting minions along with the ability to enhance and share nearby healing and shielding from her allies.

spells.name: Formless Blade
spells.text: With a snap of her whip-blade, Nilah damages any enemies she hits in a straight line in her chosen direction. This action extends her attack range for a short duration.

spells.name: Jubilant Veil
spells.text: Nilah envelops herself in mist, increasing her movement speed and allowing her to gracefully dodge all incoming attacks. Any allies she touches during the mist's duration will also gain this effect.

spells.name: Slipstream
spells.text: Nilah enthusiastically dashes toward her target, dealing damage to any enemies she passes through on the way.

spells.name: Apotheosis
spells.text: Twirling her whip-blade in joyful exuberance, Nilah deals damage to enemies around her before pulling them closer with her weapon.

archetype.value: Nilah plays more like a bruiser-assassin than a conventional ADC.

axis.value: Nilah should stay in experience range through her weak first two levels and look for all-ins when she is up a level.

winCondition.value: Nilah takes towers quickly and can use Q to take plates when enemies are forced to recall.

spikes.why: Nilah can use her experience advantage to catch enemies off guard.

spikes.at: When Jubilant Veil comes off cooldown
spikes.why: Nilah can again dodge incoming attacks during its mist.

mistakes.value: Nilah gives up her biggest playmaking tool when she starts a fight with R unnecessarily.
Nilah loses damage when she fails to weave basic attacks between Q and E casts.
